deeper.title: What the price assumes
deeper.text: The price assumes about 11% a year growth in free cash flow for 10 years, then 3% (discount rate 10.0% = 10-year Treasury 5.0% + 5%; base: last 12 months of free cash flow). For comparison, sales grew 8% last year; -0%/yr over 3 years — roughly in line with its recent growth.

deeper.title: Return on capital
deeper.text: Not meaningful (the company holds more cash than its debt plus equity, or data is missing); return on shareholders' equity 40% (3 years ago 39%).

deeper.title: Signed future revenue
deeper.text: Signed but not yet delivered (remaining performance obligations): $1.4B, up from $1M a year ago — about 15% of the last 12 months of sales; customer prepayments not yet earned (deferred revenue): $695M, up 0% from a year ago.

deeper.title: Multi-year view
deeper.text: Sales grew -0%/yr over 3 years and 5%/yr over 5 years.

deeper.title: Cash returned to shareholders
deeper.text: Returned $1.9B to shareholders over the last 12 months ($1.3B buybacks + $618M dividends) = 4.2% of the company's market value. Share count down 1.2% from a year ago (buybacks outpacing stock pay).

deeper.title: Analyst estimates
deeper.text: Next year's earnings-per-share estimate $16.73, up 0% in 90 days; 10 analysts raised, 3 cut in 30 days. This year's earnings-per-share estimate $15.02, up 1% in 90 days (up 1% in the last 30); 13 analysts raised, 5 cut in 30 days. Source: Yahoo (unofficial).

deeper.title: Where sales come from
deeper.text: By segment, latest year vs a year earlier: Intelligent Devices 47% of sales, up 11%; Software & Control 31% of sales, up 18%; Lifecycle Services 23% of sales, down 6%. Source: 10-K XBRL.

tiles.title: Sales growth
tiles.sub: latest quarter +1% vs a year earlier · 12-month sales $9.0B
tiles.read: Latest quarter: sales are flat vs a year earlier: the business isn't growing right now.
tiles.explain: Headline: sales over the last 12 months vs the 12 months before. Bars: each quarter's sales vs the same quarter a year earlier.

tiles.title: Profit margins
tiles.read: Each $100 of sales leaves $23 of operating profit, about the same as a year ago.
tiles.explain: Operating margin = operating profit ÷ sales. Gross margin = what's left after the direct cost of the product.

tiles.title: Free cash flow
tiles.read: It turned 121% of its reported profit into spare cash: the profits are real money, not just accounting.
tiles.explain: Free cash flow = cash from operations minus spending on equipment and buildings: money the company could return or reinvest.

tiles.title: Price vs profits (P/E)
tiles.read: You pay 31× last year's profit (higher than 52% of the last 5 years).
tiles.explain: P/E = share price ÷ earnings per share. Forward P/E uses next year's forecast earnings.

tiles.explain: Consensus = the average analyst forecast (Yahoo, unofficial). The typical move is the average size of the stock's next-day move after its last reports, not an options-implied figure.
